input.title: Missing material standard for filter gravel
input.message: The short text "Filterkies 16/32 liefern und als Filterpackung einbauen" does not specify the applicable material standard (e.g., DIN 4220) or performance criteria for the filter pack.
input.reference: VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 – clear and exhaustive description required; DIN 4220 – specifications for filter gravel
input.suggestion: Add: "Filterkies nach DIN 4220, Körnung 16‑32 mm, geeignet für Filterpackungen gemäß Fachplan".
